UserPublicProfile.title: UserPublicProfile
UserPublicProfile.description: Non-PII public profile and preferences for a Rocketiee AI user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

UserPrivateInfo.title: UserPrivateInfo
UserPrivateInfo.description: Strictly isolated PII record for a Rocketiee AI user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

email.description: Verified email address of the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was last updated.

Conversation.title: Conversation
Conversation.description: A chat conversation thread owned by a signed-in user.

userId.description: UID of the user who owns this conversation.

lastMessagePreview.description: Short preview snippet of the latest message.

messageCount.description: Total number of messages in the conversation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the conversation was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the conversation was last updated.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: An individual message within a conversation subcollection.

userId.description: UID of the owner of the conversation.

content.description: Markdown text content of the message.

feedback.description: User feedback rating on the AI response.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was last updated.

/users/{userId}/public/{docId}.description: Stores public display preferences for each user.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Stores isolated PII (email) for each user.

/conversations/{conversationId}.description: Stores conversation metadata for signed-in users.

/conversations/{conversationId}/messages.description: Subcollection of chat messages belonging to a conversation.
